newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT-Cementos Paz del Rio.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Cementos Paz del Rio.

text.p: Santander Investment said it was initiating coverage of Colombian cement manufacturer Cementos Paz del Rio with a buy rating.
-- Santander said it had set a 12-month target price of $20.25 for the company's shares, a level that implies 27 percent upside from current levels.

-- Paz del Rio is Colombia's sixth-largest cement company in terms of sales volume and Santander said its operating performance had improved substantially since it came under new management early last year following a period of losses in 1995.
